description: Waits for a clip that cut_clip answered 'cutting' for, and returns its download link when the file is ready. Takes the job code from that cut_clip result and waits up to 40 seconds per call; a status still 'cutting' means the cut is still running. That cut is charged once, only when its file exists; a second cut_clip for the same window would be a second job. A cut that failed says so here, and nothing was charged.

job.description: The job code (cj…) from a cut_clip result with status 'cutting'

name: cut_clip_status
title: Get a clip that cut_clip was still cutting
